items.title: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon tops the charts (for now)
items.summary: 谷歌发布的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上以 59 分超越 Claude Opus 5.5，较上周发布的 Argon 提升 9 分，并创下长输入推理（+24 分）和黑客任务（+12 分）等关键基准测试的新纪录；该模型定价为每百万输入/输出 token 分别 $2/$10，仅为竞品 Astra 的 1/5 和 Opus 5.5 的一半，目前仅限部分网络防御者使用，尚未向公众开放。
items.summary_en: Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon, a cybersecurity-focused frontier model that tops 15 of 17 benchmarks and scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, outperforming Claude Opus 5.5 and Google's previous Argon model. The model leads in long-input reasoning, hacking, and math, and offers intro API pricing of $2 per million input tokens, which is half the cost of competing options. Access is currently restricted to select cyber defenders, with no public release date yet.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
items.summary: 谷歌发布的Gemini 4 Carbon以59分登顶Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5，在HLE-Diamond等4项评估中位列第一，其编码能力紧随Claude Opus 5.5之后，并因较后者低23%的单任务成本（$7.76 vs $10.04）而具备性价比优势。该模型支持1M tokens上下文及多模态输入，通过提升复杂推理和科学知识表现实现智能化升级，目前向用户开放50%首发折扣，但尚未全面公开。
items.summary_en: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon becomes the #1 model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with a score of 59, ranking second only to Claude Opus 5.5 on the Coding Agent Index where it scores 59 with Antigravity CLI versus 62 for Claude Code. The model costs $7.76 per task at standard pricing of $4/$20 per 1M input/output tokens—approximately 23% less than Claude Opus 5.5—and features a 1M token context window with multimodal text, image, video, and speech input. Although Gemini 4 Carbon leads in complex reasoning and scientific tasks, it remains behind competitors in agentic knowledge work, scoring 1609 Elo on AA-Briefcase, but offers the second-lowest hallucination rate at 11%.

items.summary: Anthropic 2026 年第二季度营收跃升至 116 亿美元并首次实现营业利润，现金储备规模仅次于 Google 和 Berkshire Hathaway，但第三季度增速放缓至 168 亿美元。面对向亚马逊、SpaceXAI 等承诺的数千亿美元算力支出，若 Claude Code 等产品需求接近饱和导致营收增长无法继续指数级攀升，公司将面临巨大的财务兑现压力。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s S-1 filing reveals strong financial health, with Q2 2026 revenue reaching $11.6 billion—up from $4.7 billion in Q1—and cash reserves exceeding all non-bank companies except Google and Berkshire Hathaway. However, a deceleration in growth (Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion) raises concerns about the company’s ability to meet its multi-hundred-billion-dollar compute commitments to Amazon, Google, and others, which require massive annual revenue scales to offset.

items.title: ruvnet/RuView
items.summary: RuView 利用低成本 ESP32 传感器捕获 WiFi 信道状态信息（CSI），无需摄像头即可实现实时空间感知、生命体征监测及人体姿态估计，核心能力涵盖通过墙壁检测存在、非接触式心率呼吸测量及活动识别。该系统原生支持 Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home 及 Amazon Alexa 四大智能家庭生态，每个节点输出 21 个实体状态（含 11 个原始信号与 10 个语义推断状态），并可通过 Matter 协议或 HA-DISCO MQTT 进行集成。
items.why_now: RuView开放MCP服务器支持ChatGPT/Claude接入，填补AI直接操控WiFi传感的空白。
items.summary_en: RuView is a WiFi sensing platform that converts Channel State Information (CSI) from low-cost ESP32 sensors into real-time spatial intelligence, including contactless vital sign monitoring (breathing and heart rate), 17-keypoint pose estimation, and fall detection without cameras. The system integrates natively with Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home, and Alexa via a Matter Bridge, exposing 21 entities per node to enable semantic state monitoring like sleep quality and elderly inactivity anomalies. It supports a unified RF world model combining WiFi, radar, and UWB data, managed through a local HOMECORE automation engine and an AI-driven "MetaHarness" for automated calibration and verification.

items.title: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络
items.summary: Alphabet 股价单日暴跌 12.6% 并蒸发约 5000 亿美元市值，主要原因是 Google AI Mode 尽管拥有约 10 亿月活用户，但其变现能力低于传统搜索，且公司计划投入高达 2050 亿美元的资本支出导致自由现金流为负 90 亿美元。与此同时，Reddit 因搜索流量下滑将股价下挫 15%，迫使 CEO Steve Huffman 推行强制登录策略以保护数据并增强广告定向，尽管其广告收入同比增长 54% 至 8.47 亿美元。这一“AI 回答留住价值”与“网站加设访问门槛”的闭环，正推动开放互联网向封闭、高成本的授权经济收缩。

items.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑
items.summary: Reddit 在 Q3 财报中宣布转向以登录为主的体验以应对 AI 搜索冲击，此举旨在保护数据免受 AI 抓取并推进与模型提供商的授权协议。受此趋势影响，Reddit 10 月搜索引荐流量每周减少超 100 万次，美国日活降至 5070 万，但公司通过广告及 AI 数据授权实现 Q3 营收同比增长 53% 至 8.95 亿美元，净利润达 2.83 亿美元。该策略将先在美国以外市场测试，利用登录用户的行为信号优化广告定向及新的“For You”算法推荐，以提升单用户变现能力。
items.why_now: Reddit 10月搜索引荐周减百万，Q4启动登录制测试，为依赖SEO流量的产品敲响警钟。
items.why_now_en: AI 搜索致 Reddit 周失百万流量，登录制测试开启

items.title: 不认字的 AI，却很会说话
items.summary: 前推特联合创始人 Jack Dorsey 旗下的 Block 团队推出语音模型 Dessa，通过剔除文字直接进行语音到语音（speech-to-speech）训练，实现自然插话与附和，并支持在配备 M4 Max 芯片的 MacBook Pro 上本地运行。与此同时，xAI 推出主打实时交互的 Grok Voice 3.0，将响应延迟优化至半秒以内，目前该系统每日处理约 2 万通 Starlink 客服来电，其中七成无需转接人工。尽管语音 AI 在驾车等线性场景优势明显，但由于声音缺乏并行信息处理能力且受物理环境限制，在复杂办公与多选项审阅场景中仍无法替代可视化界面。
items.why_now: 10月中旬OpenAI与xAI同推新语音模型，车载及客服场景即时落地，语音入口竞争窗口已开启。
items.summary_en: Jack Dorsey's Block has launched Dessa, a text-free speech AI that processes audio directly, enabling natural interruptions and local execution on an M4 Max MacBook Pro. In parallel, xAI's Grok Voice 3.0 and OpenAI's GPT-Live advancements focus on sub-second latency for real-time applications; Grok specifically handles approximately 20,000 Starlink customer service calls daily, resolving 70% of issues without human intervention. Despite these improvements in verbal agents, the article argues that screens remain superior for complex tasks like coding and multitasking due to the linear nature of sound versus the visual efficiency of displaying parallel data.

items.title: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk 1-bit GGUF 量化版，可本地运行 1T 参数模型
items.summary: Unsloth 发布了 Mistral Le Chonk（Mistral Large 4）的 Dynamic 1-bit GGUF 量化版，该模型基于 1T 参数 MoE 架构（52B 激活），将原 1.1TB 的 FP8 模型体积压缩至约 233GB，缩减 80%，并保留了 91% 的 top-1 准确率。用户可利用 Mac Studio 在 256-270GB 内存环境下本地运行该模型，它支持文本与图像多模态输入、1M 上下文长度及 160+ 种语言处理。
items.why_now: Mistral 1T 模型刚发布 1-bit 量化版，使 Mac Studio 本地运行 1M 上下文大模型成为现实。
items.why_now_en: Mistral Large 4 now runs locally, opening a window for private 1T MoE deployment.

items.title: How I export ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini chats locally
items.summary_en: ChatGPT and Claude offer full data exports via Settings, emailing a download link to a zip containing searchable HTML or raw JSON, while Gemini requires using Google Takeout since it lacks a one-click in-app export. To convert these exports into local markdown, users can copy individual replies to preserve code fences or parse the JSON using a simple 20-line Python/Node script that generates a .md file per conversation. Key limitations include the all-or-nothing nature of full exports, expiring download links, and the loss of images and attachments during the copy-to-text process.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: pbakaus/impeccable 是一款为编码代理提供设计词汇库的工具，通过 npx impeccable install 安装后支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 18 种开发环境。其核心包含 62 条确定性规则用于检测 AI 生成内容的常见设计缺陷，并提供 critique 和 audit 命令对界面进行可用性评分及无障碍、性能等技术审计。用户可通过 24 个特定指令（如 /impeccable bolder 或 /impeccable polish）对现有界面组件进行精细化调整和优化，无需 LLM 即可捕捉设计问题。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design-vocabulary framework for coding agents that uses 24 natural-language commands—such as "bolder," "critique," and "polish"—to replace generic AI UI patterns with specific, directed design improvements. It employs 62 deterministic, non-LLM rules to detect common "AI slop" design flaws like excessive gradients and nested cards, while generating context files (PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md) to maintain brand consistency. The tool integrates via a single `npx impeccable install` command and supports major platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.

items.why_now_en: Official Expo agent skills launch for AI coding tools
items.summary_en: Expo has released official AI agent skills that provide focused knowledge for building, deploying, and debugging Expo applications, ensuring agents correctly apply Expo, EAS, React Native, and mobile platform constraints. The toolchain supports installation across multiple environments via the `skills` CLI (e.g., `npx skills@latest add expo/skills --skill '*'`) for Cursor and OpenCode, or dedicated plugins for Claude Code and Codex. Included capabilities cover open-source framework tasks such as Expo Router navigation and Reanimated animations, alongside distinct EAS service workflows with clear free-versus-paid boundary labeling.

items.title: Google 三季度搜索增速不及预期，投资者担忧 AI 搜索变现拖累核心业务

However, the company’s Cloud segment revenue surged 103% to $30.7 billion, driving Q3 capital expenditure to $51.4 billion as Google scales its infrastructure for AI agents and Gemini users, which reached 1 billion.

items.title: 一块面包，就让全球机器人集体破防？幕后真相终于被这家黑马破解
items.summary: 极智嘉推出的Gravity Control因果干预模型，通过自然语言提示在推理阶段直接调节机器人内部特征，解决了分布外（OOD）任务的局部动作偏差问题，使整体成功率从17.5%提升至87.5%，其中横放面包单项成功率由5%飙升至95%。该方案无需更新模型权重或重新采集数据，通过引入稀疏自编码器（Top-K SAE）提取可解释特征并建立因果属性链，实现了从可解释到可控制的完整闭环，相比传统“堆数据”重训模式将纠偏周期大幅压缩。

items.title: 后训练越多模型越“轴”？给参数加点扰动，探索能力回来了 | NeurIPS'26
items.summary: 上海创智学院、复旦大学等团队提出PSN-RLVR方法，通过在强化学习解题前向模型MLP/FFN模块注入贯穿整段推理的小幅参数扰动，恢复因后训练导致的探索能力缺失。在Qwen3-4B-Base等模型上，该方法将数学基准的平均pass@256成功率从70.70%提升至74.56%至76.10%，并显著提升GPQA Diamond和LiveCodeBench等分布外任务性能，甚至发现了基线多次采样未出现的全新解题视角。

items.title: 为什么新模型发布，都要先做一个游戏？
items.summary: 2026年10月，代码Agent跨过制作可玩游戏的门槛，AI模型发布演示逐渐从跑分转向生成基于Three.js或Phaser的浏览器游戏，以综合检验代码生成、空间理解及状态管理等能力。例如，Claude Opus 5.5通过统筹多Agent生成约5.5万行代码制作了仿《使命召唤》游戏，并展现出超越早期模型的游戏设计能力，如自动补齐难度递进与反馈机制，使《Battle Drones》等作品从“能跑”进化为“好玩”。尽管模型能快速拼装熟悉的游戏范式，但如《Neon Palms》项目耗时3天、经历11轮迭代及69次Agent运行仍属原型展示，与商业级游戏的长期维护仍有本质差距。
items.summary_en: Game development has become a standard benchmark for new AI models like Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Genie 4, utilizing browser-based frameworks like Three.js to test complex capabilities in spatial understanding, state management, and physics simulation. For instance, Claude Opus 5.5 generated a Three.js FPS game from approximately 55,000 lines of code, but the flagship demo "Neon Palms" required 69 agent runs over three days to complete, highlighting that while single-prompt demos are used for marketing, production-grade results still require significant iterative computation and multi-agent workflows.

US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
items.summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报机构对为新加坡AI云公司Megaspeed（美格司普）高管黄丽（Alice Huang）进行了一年监控，怀疑她是中国间谍，旨在窃取英伟达（Nvidia）CEO黄仁勋关于说服特朗普政府放松AI芯片出口限制的战略情报。Megaspeed此前已被美国商务部调查，指控其通过转售受限芯片帮助中国公司规避出口管制。

items.title: Wiz 分析智能体攻击的七大指纹与发展趋势
items.summary: Wiz 基于 ARTEX、Hermes 等框架及韩国金融、泰国财政部等真实案例，提炼出智能体攻击的七大指纹，指出其通过 LLM 驱动实现机器节奏迭代、自然语言推理嵌入及高频工具定制。典型特征包括攻击 A 中 24 小时生成 99 个定制脚本、攻击 B 中 602 个步骤以秒级可变延迟执行，以及攻击 C 中 21 小时持续写入含 803 行人类可读注释的自解释工具，显著区别于传统预制扫描器或人工操作。这些指纹揭示了 AI 智能体在侦察、利用及横向移动阶段压缩高技能实操工作、提升攻击速度与规模化的能力，为防御方识别与自动化合法流量间的细微差异提供关键检测依据。
items.summary_en: Wiz analyzes real-world agentic AI attacks involving frameworks like ARTEX and Hermes, noting that the ARTEX-driven campaign linked to the ConnectWise supply chain breach and a Korean financial sector leak of approximately 67,000 personal records successfully targeted over 2,250 tenants. The analysis identifies seven detection fingerprints, primarily "machine-paced, continuous iteration" where agents deploy custom scripts every 1-2 minutes for durations exceeding 21 hours, a cadence distinct from human manual efforts or fixed scanner patterns. Key operational signatures include embedded natural-language reasoning within generated tools—evidenced by scripts containing 803 lines of human-readable comments explaining step-by-step logic—which allows defenders to distinguish autonomous LLM-driven intrusions from legitimate automation.

items.title: 纽约时报称中国情报人员瞄准英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋
items.summary: 《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构认定新加坡Megaspeed高管Alice Huang为中国情报人员，其马来西亚姊妹公司在2024年6月至2026年2月间采购了价值至少48亿美元的搭载英伟达芯片的AI硬件，协助中国获取受限算力。特朗普政府虽在约一年前获悉此事，但为避免冲击英伟达芯片销售及加剧贸易紧张未采取行动，黄仁勋对此毫不知情，Megaspeed已启动内部调查，中国使馆则驳斥指控为抹黑。
items.summary_en: The New York Times reports that US intelligence agencies believe Alice Huang, a Singaporean executive at data center operator Megaspeed, acted as a Chinese spy to pass information to Beijing while maintaining close ties with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Megaspeed’s Malaysian affiliate procured at least $4.8 billion in Nvidia-equipped AI hardware between June 2024 and February 2026, leading US officials to suspect it facilitated China’s access to advanced chips, though the Chinese embassy dismissed the claims as baseless and President Trump took no action to avoid disrupting Nvidia sales or escalating trade tensions.

items.title: 派早报：全球首款 Android XR 有线眼镜 XREAL AURA 发售等
items.summary: XREAL AURA 作为全球首款 Android XR 有线眼镜发售，限时售价 1099 美元起，采用 12GB/16GB 存储配置、双索尼 Micro-OLED 屏幕（70° 视场角）及 3ms 延迟空间协处理器，计算模块搭载 48 TOPS AI 算力。腾讯发布跨应用 AI 协同体系 Buddy One，整合 WorkBuddy、腾讯文档等产品，推出连续包月 700 元的 VIP 会员套餐，实现跨应用内容检索与 AI 积分共享。同时，AMD 发布 FSR SDK 2.4，为 FSR Redstone 引入 Vulkan API 支持，并将机器学习版 FSR Upscaling 4.1.2 扩展至 Radeon RX 6000 系列显卡及部分锐龙处理器。
items.summary_en: The first Android XR-powered wired smart glasses, XREAL AURA, have opened for pre-order starting at $1,099, featuring dual Sony Micro-OLED displays with 1920×1200 per-eye resolution, a 70° field of view, and a Snapdragon Reality Elite compute module delivering 48 TOPS of AI processing power. Tencent has signed an MoU with Visa to deploy its TenPay Global and Visa Direct platforms for cross-border payments, remittances, and AI agent commerce, while concurrently launching its Buddy One ecosystem for cross-app AI content search and shared credits at a 700 yuan monthly rate. Additionally, AMD released FSR SDK 2.4 adding Vulkan 1.2 support and expanding machine-learning upscaling to Radeon RX 6000 GPUs, and Microsoft confirmed it will discontinue its Copilot service on LG and Samsung smart TVs in December 2026.

items.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
items.summary: Granola 推出类 Wispr 的 Mac 端听写功能，用户通过按 “Fn” 键即可在任意应用中将语音转化为清理并格式化的文本，后续将登陆 iOS 和 Windows。Granola 与 Wispr 估值分别为 15 亿和 20 亿美元，双方功能交叉，Fireflies、Speechify 等语音初创公司也均转型为集会议记录与听写于一体的多功能应用，体现了消费级语音 AI 从单一功能向综合语音捕获体验的收敛趋势。

directions.name: CareWall: 隐私优先的居家健康监测仪表板
directions.description: 基于 WiFi CSI 传感器构建的非接触式健康监测应用，专为独居老人和护理者设计，提供无摄像头的活动异常与生命体征警报。
directions.description_en: A non-contact health monitoring app based on WiFi CSI sensors, designed for the elderly and caregivers, providing activity anomaly and vital sign alerts without cameras.
directions.target_user: 独居老人的子女、专业家庭护理人员及关注隐私的智能家居用户
directions.target_user_en: Children of elderly living alone, professional family caregivers, and privacy-conscious smart home users
core_features: 实时检测跌倒/长期静止等异常事件并推送多平台警报
非接触式心率与呼吸频率趋势可视化
无缝集成 Home Assistant 及 Matter 协议的智能设备联动
本地边缘计算处理，确保原始信号不出户，保护隐私
core_features_en: Real-time detection of anomalies like falls or prolonged inactivity with multi-platform alerts
Non-contact visualization of heart rate and respiratory rate trends
Seamless integration with Home Assistant and Matter protocol for device automation
Local edge computing processing ensures raw signals do not leave the home, protecting privacy
related_trends: 边缘 AI 与隐私计算
directions.why_now: GitHub Trending 显示 RuView 等低成本 ESP32 传感器方案正在开源社区迅速走红（入选评分 8/10），其支持 Matter 协议与主流智能家庭生态的跨源热点（3 个源报道）降低了硬件接入门槛。随着‘去摄像头化’隐私保护需求的上升，结合其 21 个实体状态输出，独立开发者可快速利用现成硬件栈，填补市场上针对独居老人、无摄像头健康监护的 SaaS 服务空白。
directions.why_now_en: GitHub Trending indicates that RuView, a low-cost ESP32 sensor solution, is rapidly gaining popularity in the open-source community (RSS rating 8/10), and its cross-source hotspot (reported by 3 sources) regarding Matter protocol and mainstream smart home ecosystem support lowers the hardware integration barrier. As the demand for 'camera-free' privacy protection rises, developers can quickly leverage the existing hardware stack to fill the gap in SaaS services for the elderly living alone that provide health monitoring without cameras.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅模式：向个人用户按月收取监控服务费，向养老机构或保险公司提供批量部署及 API 接入的企业级服务。
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription: Monthly monitoring fees for individual users and enterprise-level batch deployment and API access services for senior care institutions or insurance companies.
